DOC-001.rationale: Narwhal has a canonical project README with purpose, architecture, installation and operational context.

DOC-002.rationale: Narwhal provides CONTRIBUTING.md with contribution guidance.

DOC-003.rationale: Narwhal maintains CHANGELOG.md and tagged release history.

GOV-001.rationale: No repository Code of Conduct is currently present.

GOV-002.rationale: The .github directory currently contains Dependabot configuration and workflows but no ISSUE_TEMPLATE directory.

GOV-003.rationale: No pull request template is currently present under .github.

SEC-001.rationale: SECURITY.md documents private vulnerability reporting, supported versions, scope and known limitations.

SEC-003.rationale: Narwhal documents that CodeQL is not useful for its Bash/YAML codebase and workflow-level security analysis remains a roadmap item; no applicable security scan job is currently present in CI.

CI-001.rationale: Narwhal has multiple GitHub Actions workflows.

CI-002.rationale: Narwhal CI runs scripts/test/regression-check-kakao.sh --static as an automated regression suite.

CI-003.rationale: Narwhal CI runs ShellCheck, YAML validation, kubeconform and Markdown lint/static validation.

REL-001.rationale: Narwhal has a dedicated GitHub Actions release workflow.

REL-002.rationale: Narwhal documents version and compatibility authority through VERSIONS.md and release documentation.

PLT-001.rationale: Narwhal is explicitly a Kubernetes platform and contains repeatable Kubernetes/GitOps packaging.

PLT-002.rationale: Kubernetes workload manifests under gitops/ contain readiness, liveness or startup probe configuration.

PLT-003.rationale: Kubernetes workload manifests under gitops/ contain resource requests or limits.

PLT-005.rationale: Narwhal GitOps manifests contain PodDisruptionBudget resources including Istio and packaged component PDBs.

PLT-006.rationale: Narwhal explicitly integrates Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo and Hubble observability components.

WEB-001.rationale: The kubernetes-platform profile does not treat README badges and documentation screenshots as web-application image delivery evidence.

WEB-002.rationale: The kubernetes-platform profile does not treat README badges and documentation screenshots as web-application image delivery evidence.

WEB-003.rationale: The kubernetes-platform profile does not treat README badges and documentation screenshots as web-application image delivery evidence.

WEB-004.rationale: The kubernetes-platform profile does not treat README badges and documentation screenshots as web-application image delivery evidence.

WEB-005.rationale: The kubernetes-platform profile does not require documentation-only external images to use an image optimization pipeline.

WEB-006.rationale: Badge and documentation image hosts are not web-application runtime origin configuration for this profile.

WEB-007.rationale: Immutable web image caching is outside the default kubernetes-platform profile unless explicitly opted in.

WEB-008.rationale: Runtime web cache verification is outside the default kubernetes-platform profile unless explicitly opted in.

WEB-009.rationale: Runtime cache effectiveness verification is outside the default kubernetes-platform profile unless explicitly opted in.
